name: SouthCoast Marketplace
summary: SouthCoast Marketplace is the South Coast's most exciting retail, dining, and entertainment venue, offering a modern open-air shopping experience in Fall River, Massachusetts. This lifestyle center combines popular national retailers with diverse dining options and entertainment amenities, serving as a premier destination for the region's residents.
demographics: SouthCoast Marketplace attracts a diverse mix of families and young professionals from the Fall River area and surrounding South Coast Massachusetts communities. The trade area serves middle-income households seeking convenient access to retail, dining, and entertainment options in a modern open-air setting. Primary visitors include value-conscious shoppers aged 25-54 with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $90,000, representing a blend of suburban families and working-class residents. The center draws from a regional market that values one-stop shopping convenience combined with entertainment amenities like movie theaters, making it a popular weekend destination for the South Coast region.
description: SouthCoast Marketplace stands as the premier retail, dining, and entertainment destination on the South Coast of Massachusetts, serving the Fall River community and surrounding areas. Located at 550 William S Canning Boulevard, this modern open-air lifestyle center offers visitors a comprehensive shopping experience that combines national retailers with diverse dining options and entertainment venues. The center features a thoughtfully designed layout that encourages exploration, with convenient access and ample parking for shoppers throughout the day. Operating from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, SouthCoast Marketplace provides extended hours to accommodate busy schedules and evening entertainment seekers. With a strong 4.4-star rating from nearly 3,000 reviews, the center has established itself as a trusted community gathering place where South Coast residents can shop, dine, and enjoy quality entertainment all in one convenient location.
